main.title: DAVE THE DIVER
main.subtitle: From Sea to Plate, with Every Consequence in Between
main.summary: Dave the Diver is a 2023 video game developed and published by Mintrocket.

cards.heading: Diving by day, sushi by night
cards.text: Dave the Diver is a 2023 video game developed and published by Mintrocket. The game combines both action-adventure and management gameplay styles as players explore deep sea environments to gather ingredients for a sushi restaurant. It was released for macOS and Windows in June 2023 following an early access release in October 2022.

cards.heading: Every Dive Has Limits of Oxygen and Space
cards.text: Dave's dives have limited oxygen and carrying capacity. Going deeper can reveal valuable species and materials, but leaves a longer journey back. Filling the inventory early may mean abandoning another find later. Choosing when to return connects exploration to the supplies available for the restaurant that evening.

cards.heading: Sushi Turns the Catch into a Supply Chain
cards.text: At Bancho Sushi, the day's fish determine what can be put on the menu. Species, quantity and quality matter while the player arranges dishes, staff and upgrades. A successful catch gains value through the evening's service. The two jobs provide goals for one another as the restaurant needs send Dave back towards the sea.

cards.heading: Marine Variety Becomes Practical Knowledge
cards.text: The changing Blue Hole contains hundreds of species with different habitats, behaviour and depths. Some require particular tools or approaches. As Dave explores, the player learns where useful catches can be found and what is needed to obtain them. This practical knowledge helps plan later dives around the restaurant's resources.

main.title: Pikmin 4
main.subtitle: A small world, carefully planned
main.summary: Pikmin 4 is a 2023 real-time strategy video game co-developed by Nintendo EPD and Eighting, and published by Nintendo. It is the fourth main installment of the Pikmin series, following Pikmin 3 (2013), and the fifth installment overall. It was released on the Nintendo Switch on July 21, 2023.

cards.heading: Pikmin 4
cards.text: Pikmin 4 is a 2023 real-time strategy video game co-developed by Nintendo EPD and Eighting, and published by Nintendo. It is the fourth main installment of the Pikmin series, following Pikmin 3 (2013), and the fifth installment overall. It was released on the Nintendo Switch on July 21, 2023.

cards.heading: Directing the squad
cards.text: The player controls a minuscule character who takes command of squads of Pikmin to explore various areas, fight enemies, secure treasures, and solve puzzles. Pikmin can be directed to perform various tasks, such as carrying objects and fighting enemies, and have individual weaknesses and strengths. For example, Red Pikmin are invulnerable to fire, Blue Pikmin can walk underwater, and Winged Pikmin can lift up objects and float over hazards. The player can switch between different species of Pikmin to adapt to the situation and deal with enemies and hazards. The camera allows for a full view of the area around the player character, with the perspective being able to be much closer to the ground than in previous games.

cards.heading: A partner called Oatchi
cards.text: The player can also command a canine creature called Oatchi to help with exploration. Like the Pikmin, Oatchi can be directed to carry objects and attack enemies, but can also help bash breakable objects, sniff out objectives such as treasure, and transport both the player character and Pikmin around the map and over bodies of water; in some places, the player can directly control Oatchi to solve puzzles.

cards.heading: Night Expeditions
cards.text: Specific maps allow players to explore areas at night, which are known as Night Expeditions. In this mode, which functions similar to tower defense games, players are restricted to using only Glow Pikmin to explore maps and recover resources, all while fighting enemies who are drawn to the Glow Pikmin's nest, called a Lumiknoll.

cards.heading: The art of Dandori
cards.text: The main story can be played in either single-player or alongside a second player in co-op, who assists by throwing pebbles and items, and there is also a competitive multiplayer mode called Dandori Battle, derived from Dandori, a Japanese word for efficient planning. In Dandori Battles, which are also featured in single-player, the player must secure as much spoils and treasures in an arena before their opponent can; both sides can collect Pikmin to help them and have their own Oatchi partner. Two players can partake in Dandori Battles together, either working together against the computer or against each other.

main.title: Remnant II
main.summary: Remnant 2 is a third-person shooter action role-playing video game developed by Gunfire Games and published by Gearbox Publishing.

cards.heading: Guns and monsters across strange worlds
cards.text: Remnant 2 is a third-person shooter action role-playing video game developed by Gunfire Games and published by Gearbox Publishing. A sequel to Remnant: From the Ashes, the game was released for PlayStation 5, Windows and Xbox Series X/S on July 25, 2023.

cards.heading: Weapons, archetypes and character skills
cards.text: Like its predecessor, Remnant 2 is a third-person shooter inspired by Soulslike video games. Players can wield up to two guns, alongside their melee weapon. At the beginning of the game, players can select their character archetypes. For instance, the Gunslinger class replaces the Ex-cultist class from the first game, and focuses on the use of firearms. The Challenger class can unleash a shockwave that disintegrates enemies, while the Handler class has a dog companion who will aid in combat. Players will gain the ability to dual class as they progress in the game. Players can also activate different archetype-specific perks and skills. For the Gunslinger, their unique ability is "Loaded", which instantly reloads all the firearms the character is carrying. For the Handler class, the prime perk ability is "Bonded", which allows their dog companion to revive the character after they have fallen in combat.

cards.heading: Changing adventures and three-player co-op
cards.text: While the first game features procedural generation by changing a level's layout and enemy spawn points, it has been significantly expanded in Remnant 2. According to Gunfire Games, enemy types, the aesthetic of a region, boss characters, non-playable characters and the game's storyline and quests are also randomly generated. Players can play through the entire game solo, though the game also supports a three-player cooperative multiplayer mode.
